message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && grep -R "int blosc2_cbuffer_sizes" -n blosc && nl -ba blosc/blosc2.c | grep -A80 -n "blosc2_cbuffer_sizes" | head -100 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
for p in sorted(Path('tests/fuzz/corpus').iterdir()):
    b=p.read_bytes()
    if len(b)<112: continue
    hlen=struct.unpack('>i',b[12:16])[0]
    flen=struct.unpack('>q',b[17:25])[0]
    nbytes=struct.unpack('>q',b[31:39])[0]
    cbytes=struct.unpack('>q',b[40:48])[0]
    blocksize=struct.unpack('>i',b[54:58])[0]
    chunksize=struct.unpack('>i',b[59:63])[0]
    nchunks=(nbytes+chunksize-1)//chunksize if chunksize>0 else None
    print(p.name, 'len',len(b),'hlen',hlen,'flen',flen,'nbytes',nbytes,'cbytes',cbytes,'block',blocksize,'chunksize',chunksize,'nchunks',nchunks, 'first chunk bytes', b[hlen:hlen+16].hex(), 'offchunk', hlen+cbytes, b[hlen+cbytes:hlen+cbytes+16].hex())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
